milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted white_dye ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with only bones (not white_dye), so this can only be satisfied by crafting bone → bone_meal → white_dye. Since 4 bones yield up to 12 white_dye and only 2 are consumed later for white_wool, the player will retain white_dye even after completing task 2.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted yellow_wool ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with orange_wool (not yellow_wool or white_wool), so this can only be satisfied by completing the full chain: white_dye + orange_wool → white_wool, dandelion → yellow_dye, then yellow_dye + white_wool → yellow_wool. This milestone depends on milestone 1 (craft_white_dye) since white_dye is consumed to produce the intermediate white_wool.
